title: Ordered positive functor expressions and evaluation paths
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category [def-nagata-category], let $P_r:\mathcal C\to\mathcal C$ be endofunctors indexed by positive integers, put $T=P_1$, and use the powers of [def-trf-endofunctor-powers]. An ordered expression is inductively a symbol $[r]$ of positive weight $r$, or a product $(AB)$ of ordered expressions. Define $|[r]|=r$, $|AB|=|A|+|B|$, $\llbracket[r]\rrbracket=P_r$, and $\llbracket AB\rrbracket=\llbracket A\rrbracket\circ\llbracket B\rrbracket$ in functional order. It is complete when every symbol has weight one. For a complete expression $E$, define its canonical normalization $N_E:\llbracket E\rrbracket\xrightarrow\sim T^{|E|}$ recursively: a unit-weight symbol is identified with $T=T^1$; at a product use the two normalizations by whiskering and then the canonical power identification $T^{|A|}\circ T^{|B|}\cong T^{|A|+|B|}$, built recursively from the identity functor, the power recursion and functor associators and unitors. Given natural isomorphisms $C_{a,b}:P_{a+b}\xrightarrow\sim P_a\circ P_b$ for all positive $a,b$, an evaluation path from $E$ to $F$, with its actual evaluated natural isomorphism $q:\llbracket E\rrbracket\xrightarrow\sim\llbracket F\rrbracket$, is generated by identity paths, elementary splits $[a+b]\to([a][b])$ evaluated as $C_{a,b}$, canonical reassociations $(AB)D\leftrightarrow A(BD)$, insertion of a path in either product factor by whiskering, and finite concatenation evaluated by composition. Thus any finite sequence of allowed splits and reassociations, in arbitrary functor contexts, is an evaluation path; an evaluation path with complete endpoint is a complete ordered refinement.
